question: Test which oriented edge subspace can hold odd stock with a faithful action and normalized readback.

objects.definition: Normalized unsigned endpoint incidence followed by the signed gradient
objects.basis_orientation: ordinary input and increasing signed output

sources.section_or_object_id: Scope correction to the v0.30 intake summary

assumptions: Euclidean simplicial metrics on a regular tetrahedron.
Ordinary and signed edge actions on their typed modules.
Full S4 equivariance and an aligned pair for stock readback.

technique_plan.technique: Incidence isometry and transposition fixed spaces
technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: Type the receiver and verify stage-two readback

clock_receipt.update_rule: candidate stock transfer and isolated readback

dynamics_readout.state_space: aligned held odd registers and gradient receiver
dynamics_readout.conservation_and_sources: isometric archive with two-to-one normalization of full versus half stock
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: cycles excluded under full equivariance and lossless norm preservation

target_exposure.selection_criterion: preserve full stock and reconstruct half stock

result.exact_expression: L^T L=I on T2; h=L(sqrt(2)*a); old direct odd contribution=||h||^2/2
result.scope: The signed gradient is an equivariant isometric receiver. The signed cycles cannot carry a lossless norm-preserving full-S4 archive. The correct archive readout is half its norm squared.

counterexamples_and_failures: Cycle transposition fixed line cannot hold the unit circle
Live vertex coupling does not leave the bare gradient archive stationary
limitations: Native transfer, isolated receiver, and deficit allocation remain open
next_discriminant: Audit the vertex-edge block controls for a source-defined transfer and persistent isolation of the signed gradient receiver.
